highlights: Built automated benchmarking systems to compare AI agent behavior across model and feature iterations, generating quality metrics and performance insights that guided production releases.

Designed and developed reusable multi-calendar scheduling infrastructure inspired by Cal.com with timezone-aware booking and isolated multi-tenant databases, adopted across two independent products: JustCall and ServiceAgent.
Built reusable backend platform modules and npm packages adopted across 5+ microservices to standardize workflows and improve engineering velocity.
Built a centralized authentication platform using JWT authentication and rotating CSRF tokens for secure multi-service communication, handling ~7M authentication requests daily.
Improved distributed service reliability and horizontal scalability by tuning Kubernetes resource allocation and autoscaling thresholds based on Grafana performance metrics.
Owned architecture and backend development of ServiceAgent, including authentication, platform modules and distributed service integrations.
Designed distributed backend systems using TypeScript, NestJS, Redis and event-driven patterns supporting integrations across React, PHP and multi-service ecosystems.
Led ABDM/ABHA/HPR/HFR healthcare integrations for DRx platform under National Health Authority initiatives.
Designed scalable backend workflows supporting multi-clinic and multi-doctor operational models with reusable service abstractions and asynchronous processing patterns.
Implemented scalable backend design patterns including Callback Pattern and Facade Pattern to improve modularity and reusability.
Developed and scaled backend services for Tookan, a globally used logistics and delivery management platform supporting workforce and operational workflows.
Architected fine-grained ACL authorization systems and led integrations with external business platforms including POS, payment, accounting, and eCommerce systems.
